description.en-US: More's answer of 1529 to Simon Fish's Supplication of Beggars, in the person of the souls in purgatory: a defence of prayer for the dead and of the clergy.
description.pt-BR: A resposta de More (1529) à Suplicação dos Mendigos de Simon Fish, na pessoa das almas do purgatório: uma defesa da oração pelos mortos e do clero.

sources.edition: The supplycacyon of soulys (London: 1529), EEBO-TCP A68478.
sources.description: EEBO-TCP hand-keyed transcription, original spelling kept. 369 illegible places in the source are marked […]. Raw TEI in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Thomas More died in 1535; the edition is of 1529 and the TCP transcription is released to the public domain (CC0).
